channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: eMudhra to exit website security certification business after security weakness, company says no data breach—All we know
item.description: eMudhra will exit its SSL/TLS certificate business after weak keys were found in eight of its issuing certification authorities. The company said it revoked affected authorities within 14 hours and reported no data breach.&nbsp;

item.title: OpenAI cuts valuation target by $150 bn to $1.25 tn | Why it has scaled back its funding ambitions ahead of IPO
item.description: OpenAI has lowered its valuation target by $150 billion to $1.25 trillion as it negotiates a funding round of up to $30 billion. Investor concerns about AI spending are mounting, while the company has delayed its IPO until next year.

item.title: Multiples gears up for a billion-dollar fundraise next year
item.description: Renuka Ramnath-led Multiples is eyeing its largest fund yet, targeting $1-1.2 billion next year. Having deployed more than half of its previous fund, the private equity firm is looking to raise fresh capital as several of its peers scale up their fundraising ambitions.

item.title: TA Associates-backed OmniActive explores $200-300 million IPO at $1 bn valuation
item.description: The IPO plan follows several unsuccessful attempts to raise private capital, as macroeconomic headwinds and geopolitical conflicts weighed on investor sentiment. If the IPO goes as planned, it would make OmniActive the first pure-play nutraceutical company to list on the exchanges.

item.title: Three Iveco investors stand to gain €63 million as Tata Motors races to secure buyout
item.description: At Tata’s revised offer price of €14.40 per share, the three investors could make a combined gain of about €63 million, in addition to the estimated €288 million in extraordinary dividends received from Iveco in April.

item.title: Boardroom friction drives listed companies to law firms for governance advice
item.description: As boardroom tensions grow and governance standards tighten, companies are increasingly turning to law firms for strategic advice on independent director dissent, board processes and compliance.

item.title: Deckers results show aggressive discounts from rivals are hitting premium brands
item.description: DECKERS OUTDOOR-RESULTS/:Deckers results show aggressive discounts from rivals are hitting premium brands

item.title: UBS Defeats Ex-Credit Suisse Managing Directors’ Back-Pay Claims
item.description: UBS Group AG prevailed against two former Credit Suisse Group AG managing directors who argued their deferred-compensation certificates shouldn’t have been written down when the banks merged in 2023.

item.title: Why has Rhode Island sued Meta over scam ads on Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp? Explained
item.description: The complaint seeks civil monetary penalties for each alleged violation of Rhode Island law, restitution for affected consumers and the recovery of profits that Meta allegedly obtained unlawfully.

item.title: Vectorial raises $3 million in funding to expand its AI model that predicts consumer behaviour
item.description: Vectorial plans to use the funding to expand its datasets and models as it develops its human behaviour simulation capabilities.

item.title: Oil India shifts corporate office from Noida to New Delhi: What has changed? Check new address and details
item.description: Oil India Limited has shifted its corporate office from Noida to the World Trade Centre in New Delhi following board approval on October 21, 2026. The company's registered office will remain in Assam. Check the new office address and details.

item.title: Who is Dr Ashok Kumar? Why former Coal India GM is back in college after retirement
item.description: Ashok Kumar's return to college offers an example of lifelong learning, showing that education need not be limited to the pursuit of a qualification or professional advancement.

item.title: 7-Eleven shuts remaining 31 India outlets after ₹90 cr FY26 loss: When did it open first with Reliance; what’s next?
item.description: 7-Eleven has closed its last 31 Indian stores in Mumbai and Pune, ending its five-year franchise partnership with Reliance Retail after reporting a nearly ₹90 crore net loss in FY26. Its parent company says it remains interested in serving Indian customers through other possible strategies.

item.title: Swiggy faces quick-commerce test as Instamart losses hit ₹895 crore in Q2
item.description: Swiggy expects Instamart’s adjusted Ebitda losses to decline in the December quarter from ₹895 crore in the September quarter

item.title: Colgate-Palmolive Q2 net profit up 5.5% to ₹342 crore, narrowly misses estimates
item.description: A 12.2% increase in revenue and toothpaste volume gains drove Q2 performance, but Ebitda margin fell 287 basis points amid rising input costs and higher ad spend.

item.title: Kent RO invests ₹250 cr in Noida plant for solar inverters, lithium batteries, targets ₹1,750 cr revenue in FY27
item.description: Kent New Energy has commissioned a ₹250-crore Noida plant producing solar hybrid inverters and lithium battery packs, with capacity set to grow from 3.5 GWh to 10 GWh. Kent also plans a ₹500-crore YEIDA facility and is targeting ₹1,750 crore in revenue in FY27.

item.title: West Asia war uncertainty weighs on Jindal Stainless’ volume outlook
item.description: The company has lowered its sales volume growth guidance to 4-6% for FY27 from 7-9% earlier

item.title: ‘Starlink moves the needle’: Elon Musk as United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby says passengers switching airlines for Wi-Fi
item.description: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby says Starlink's in-flight Wi-Fi is attracting passengers from rival airlines, with Elon Musk saying the service ‘moves the needle’ as the carrier expands its rollout.

item.title: SpaceX’s 20% pay rise for temporary relocation: How Elon Musk’s AI data centre expansion is driving hiring needs
item.description: SpaceX is offering employees a 20% pay premium for six-week assignments in Memphis, Tennessee, and Southaven, Mississippi, as it accelerates the expansion of its Colossus data centres.&nbsp;

item.title: Swiggy's Q2 loss narrows on food delivery gains, misses estimates
item.description: Swiggy's revenue from operations rose 36.1% year-on-year to 75.71 billion rupees, beating analysts' estimate of 72.81 billion rupees, per LSEG data.

item.title: Flipkart tests ‘Eat-in by Minutes’ in Bengaluru to challenge Zomato, Swiggy in food delivery market
item.description: Flipkart's planned entry comes at a time when the country's food services industry is witnessing strong growth.

item.title: UBS converts 360 One warrants into 4.8% equity stake after 2025 deal
item.description: The latest tranche of equity shares was issued at ₹1,030 per share, bringing the total consideration for the warrant transaction to ₹2,112 crore.

item.title: KKR, OTPP-backed Vertis eyes IPO filing by Dec-Jan, public listing by April 2027
item.description: KKR- and OTPP-backed Vertis Infrastructure Trust plans to file a draft offer document by December and list publicly by April-May 2027, with the sponsors selling a combined 13-14% stake (over ₹2,000 crore) via an offer for sale.

item.title: 43 million ‘willful violations’: Here’s why Meta has been ordered to pay $25 billion in privacy case
item.description: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion for misleading residents about privacy and the spread of harmful content. The ruling followed a jury finding more than 43 million violations of state law.&nbsp;

item.title: BioWare games shutdown: What's next for Baldur’s Gate, Neverwinter Nights, Star Wars, Dragon Age, Mass Effect, Anthem?
item.description: According to an official BioWare blog post, the fate of Dragon Age, Mass Effect and its other beloved intellectual properties remains a complex web of cancellations, shifting priorities, and third-party licensing.

item.title: DeepSeek raises $15 billion to challenge Anthropic, OpenAI and other US AI labs
item.description: The Chinese AI pioneer DeepSeek has raised about 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) in its latest fundraising round, one of the country’s largest ever and a sign of the startup’s ambitions to compete globally with the likes of Anthropic PBC and OpenAI.

item.title: Cognizant is putting 18,000 engineers behind Google Gemini: What they will build and why
item.description: Cognizant and Google Cloud are assigning more than 18,000 employees to develop AI agents for clients, targeting software modernisation, developer tools, business-process automation and cybersecurity.&nbsp;

item.title: Why a PHP bug is a business risk, not just an IT problem: ‘Next step could be the mass compromise of…’
item.description: A decade-old PHP vulnerability affecting software behind about 75% of identifiable websites has triggered emergency fixes and service shutdowns across Europe.&nbsp;

item.title: India’s luxury watch boom is ticking. Franck Muller wants a bigger share
item.description: India is emerging as a bright spot for Swiss watchmakers amid uneven global demand. Franck Muller sees the market closing the gap with Singapore and the UAE, and is exploring airport retail, celebrity partnerships and branded residences, though demand for watches above ₹50 lakh remains limited.

item.title: Corporate VCs bullish on India but rush is yet to start: TDK Ventures founder Nicolas Sauvage
item.description: Semiconductors, AI infrastructure and robotics are the main areas of interest in India, alongside energy transition and digital transformation.

item.title: Flipkart-owned fashion e-commerce giant Myntra’s FY26 financials: How falling logistics income dragged revenue down
item.description: Myntra’s operating revenue declined in FY26 as logistics revenue fell 53.2% to ₹1,119.2 crore, outweighing modest marketplace growth and a 35.2% rise in advertising income.&nbsp;

item.title: BioWare games shutdown: No end to job cuts? What led to 400 layoffs at Electronic Arts? What official blog confirmed
item.description: According to Bloomberg, BioWare's latest title, Dragon Age: The Veilguard, fell short of sales expectations, which had already prompted EA to impose steep cuts at the developer last year.

item.title: SpaceX offers 20% extra pay for relocation to Memphis or Southaven | What’s the deal?
item.description: SpaceX is offering employees a 20% pay premium for six-week assignments in Memphis, Tennessee, and Southaven, Mississippi, to speed up construction of its Colossus AI data centres.&nbsp;

item.title: PHP2Shell vulnerability: ‘Most significant security issues…,’ How Google, OpenAI and Amazon respond to the cyber threat
item.description: Critical PHP vulnerabilities known as PHP2Shell could let attackers remotely execute code and access sensitive data. Amazon detected exploitation attempts before public disclosure, while Google and OpenAI researchers helped identify and investigate the flaws.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘Claude resented me for ghosting’: Deepinder Goyal reveals why he built privacy-first AI assistant Dark.ai
item.description: Deepinder Goyal explained that Dark.ai is being developed around a central promise of privacy-by-design.
